title: Behavior Beyond Text: Evaluating Refusal Transfer Failure in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents, their safety evaluations still focus primarily on their ability to refuse harmful requests in text. We investigate whether the refusal behavior in text transfers to tool use. We construct a benchmark of 2,304 prompts across four domains, consisting of matched triplets that present the same harmful or benign request in text-only, standard tool-enabled, and adversarially framed tool-enabled settings. We then assess tool-call safety using 20 predefined forbidden actions. Testing five models of varying sizes and families, we find that requests refused in text frequently result in unsafe tool calls. Under standard tool-enabled prompting, this divergence occurs for 10-52 percent of harmful requests refused in chat. translated_title: 行为不止于文本：评估大语言模型智能体中的拒绝行为迁移失效
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被部署为工具调用智能体，其安全评估仍然主要集中在它们在文本中拒绝有害请求的能力上。我们研究了文本中的拒绝行为是否会迁移到工具使用场景中。我们构建了一个涵盖四个领域、共2,304个提示词的基准测试，由匹配的三元组组成，这些三元组在纯文本、标准工具启用和对抗性框架的工具启用三种设置下呈现相同的有害或良性请求。随后，我们使用20个预定义的禁止操作来评估工具调用的安全性。通过测试五个不同规模和系列的模型，我们发现文本中被拒绝的请求经常导致不安全的工具调用。在标准工具启用的提示下，这种分歧发生在聊天中被拒绝的有害请求的10%至52%。为了从机制层面研究这一差距，我们在五个模型各自的残差流中识别出了一个与拒绝行为相关的方向。我们发现……
tldr: 该论文揭示了大语言模型的文本拒绝安全行为无法可靠迁移到工具调用场景——在聊天中被拒绝的有害请求中有10%至52%会在工具启用时引发不安全的工具调用，并通过残差流中的拒绝方向对这一失效机制进行了分析。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that LLMs' text-based safety refusal behavior fails to transfer to tool-calling scenarios—10-52% of harmful requests refused in chat lead to unsafe tool calls when tools are enabled—and mechanistically analyzes this transfer failure via a refusal-associated direction in the residual stream.
